notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a removable +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Yorvo triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.
